title: tephroseris wagneri
intro: Tephroseris wagneri, commonly known as Alpine Everlasting or Edelweiss, is a flowering plant in the daisy family native to the high-altitude mountainous regions of the Himalayas. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems, fever, and inflammation, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Tephroseris wagneri include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to soothe and protect the body. Its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its therapeutic actions.
